description: This file defines a Flutter widget for rendering a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe game board, including individual cell widgets, handling user interactions, and visual styles. It utilizes state management through Provider to interact with game logic and manages animations for hover and press effects.

classes.name: TicTacToeBoard
classes.description: A widget representing a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe grid with animated cell interactions.

classes.name: _Cell
classes.description: A widget representing an individual cell of the Tic Tac Toe board, handling tap animations and display.

classes.name: _CellState
classes.description: State class for _Cell, managing tap animation scale.

methods.name: build (TicTacToeBoard)
methods.description: Builds the Tic Tac Toe grid layout with interactive cells.

methods.name: build ( _CellState )
methods.description: Builds the animated cell widget, handling gesture detection and styling.

methods.name: _onTapDown
methods.description: Handles tap down event, applying scale animation.

methods.name: _onTapCancel
methods.description: Handles tap cancel event, reverting scale.

methods.name: _onTapUp
methods.description: Handles tap up event, reverting scale.
